title: Supply of Stepper Motor and Stepper Motor Controller for various Lighthouses at Chennai Directorate - Reg.
summary: Notice inviting sealed quotations from reputed firms or authorised dealers for supply of four 40 kg.cm stepper motors and four matching stepper motor controllers for lighthouses under the Chennai Directorate.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai

scope.item: Stepper Motor 40Kg.cm, shaft length 100 mm, shaft dia 12 mm, torque 40 kg.cm

Stepper Motor Controller 40 Kg.cm for the above stepper motor (ON/OFF switch, direction switch, 0-35 RPM, 230V AC/50 Hz with provision for DC 12V battery supply, step angle 1.8 deg full step +/-5% non-cumulative)

money.notes: No estimate or EMD printed. Terms: GST inclusive, transportation inclusive, 100% payment after supply; paying authority Director, DLL Chennai. Schedule nonetheless has separate Total / GST / Grand total rows.

period.warranty: Standard warranty one year against any manufacturing defects

eligibility: Reputed firms or authorised dealer or agent; quotation with necessary credentials and descriptive brochures
specs: Stepper motor 40 kg.cm torque, shaft 100 mm long x 12 mm dia
Controller: ON/OFF and direction switches, 0-35 RPM, 230V AC 50 Hz plus DC 12V battery provision, 1.8 deg step angle +/-5% non-cumulative
notes: Scanned 3-page NIQ with poor OCR layer; all pages read from rendered images (schedule page is rotated). NIQ dated 28/11/2023. The Hindi paragraph gives the submission date as 15.11.2023 (before the notice date, apparently copied from an earlier NIQ) while the English gives 11.12.2023 15:00, opening same day 16:00; English date matches the listing end date. Delivery to Director, DLL, 5/20 Jaffer Syrang Street, Chennai; individual lighthouses not named.
